name: Fat Pack | 4g Prepackaged Flower | Hollywood Runtz
description: Fat Pack: The Original 4 Gram Eighth – a half gram better. A delicious cross of Sunset Sherbet x Runtz, Hollywood Runtz shines with uplifting, happy, and creative energy. Its tropical berry aroma comes from Limonene, Myrcene, and Humulene, delivering a social and euphoric vibe. Great for daytime hangs or evening fun.
